name: What preparation steps should I take before a garage cabinet consultation?

mainEntity.name: What preparation steps should I take before a garage cabinet consultation?

acceptedAnswer.text: Before your garage cabinet consultation, it's helpful to consider your primary storage goals and what you typically store in your garage. Think about the types of items – tools, sports gear, holiday decorations, or chemicals – and their approximate sizes. Having a general idea of your budget is also beneficial. You don't need to clear out your garage entirely, but knowing what you want to achieve with the new cabinets will help us design a system that truly meets your needs. Gathering these thoughts beforehand makes the consultation more productive.
acceptedAnswer.description: Before a consultation, consider your storage goals, the types and sizes of items you store, and a general budget. This helps design a system for your needs.
